## Phase 1 — API Contract & Data Model

<!-- GUIDANCE: Always first — everything else depends on the agreed contract and schema. -->

**Goal:** Agree the OpenAPI contract and database schema changes before any service code is written.
**Deliverable:** Reviewed `specs/openapi.yaml` diff + reversible Drizzle migration, no running code yet.

- [ ] **Task 1.1:** Update `specs/openapi.yaml` with new/changed paths and schema components
  - Files affected: `specs/openapi.yaml`
  - Reference: [FR-N]

- [ ] **Task 1.2:** Update `src/db/schema.ts` and generate the migration
  - Files affected: `src/db/schema.ts`, `src/db/migrations/[generated].sql` *(generated by `npm run db:generate` — do not hand-write)*
  - Reference: [Data Model Changes section of spec]
  - ⚠️ **Risk:** [Any known lock/data risk for this specific change, or omit if none]

- [ ] **Task 1.3:** Add/update Zod schemas in `src/schemas/`
  - Files affected: `src/schemas/[resource].schemas.ts`
  - Reference: [spec's Zod Schema Changes section — must match `specs/openapi.yaml` exactly]

## Phase 2 — Service & Route Implementation

**Goal:** Implement the business logic and HTTP surface conforming to the Phase 1 contract.
**Deliverable:** All new/changed endpoints functional and unit-tested.

- [ ] **Task 2.1:** Implement/update service method(s)
  - Files affected: `src/services/[name].service.ts`
  - Reference: [spec FR-N; follow pattern in nearest existing `*.service.ts`]

- [ ] **Task 2.2:** Implement/update route handler(s)
  - Files affected: `src/routes/[name].router.ts`
  - Reference: [spec FR-N; OpenAPI endpoint definition]
  - Must apply: `authenticate` middleware (if protected), `validate` middleware against the Zod schema, and return `Result<T, AppError>` errors via `next(err)`

- [ ] **Task 2.3:** Register the router in `src/app.ts` (if new)

- [ ] **Task 2.4:** Write unit tests for the service
  - Files affected: `tests/unit/[name].service.test.ts`
  - Coverage target: happy path, [error condition 1], [error condition 2], [edge case]
  - Mock `ioredis` / `pg` per project convention

- [ ] **Task 2.5:** Write integration tests for the route(s)
  - Files affected: `tests/integration/[name].test.ts`
  - ACs covered: AC-1, AC-2, AC-3
  - Uses real Postgres + Redis via Testcontainers — do not mock in integration tests

---

## Phase 3 — Tests & Validation

**Goal:** Full acceptance-criteria coverage and quality gates green.
**Deliverable:** All ACs have passing test evidence; typecheck/lint/coverage pass.

- [ ] **Task 3.1:** Run spec compliance check
  - Prompt: `/review` — verifies the implementation against `specs/[feature-name].spec.md`. For each AC: PASS (with evidence) or FAIL.
  - **Gate:** All ACs must be PASS before PR creation

- [ ] **Task 3.2:** Run security review (mandatory for any auth/token/PII-handling code)
  - Prompt: `Use @.claude/agents/security-reviewer.md to review the changed files. Focus on auth gaps, input validation, token handling, rate limiting, and data exposure.`
  - **Gate:** All Critical and High findings must be resolved before PR creation

- [ ] **Task 3.3:** Run API contract check (if `specs/openapi.yaml` changed)
  - Prompt: `Use @.claude/agents/api-contract-checker.md to verify specs/openapi.yaml, src/schemas/, and src/routes/ are consistent for this change.`

- [ ] **Task 3.4:** Verify coverage and quality gates
  - `npm run test:coverage` — ≥80% line/branch coverage on new code
  - `npm run typecheck` — zero errors
  - `npm run lint` — zero warnings

- [ ] **Task 3.5:** Create PR
  - Prompt: `/pr-create` → generates structured PR description from spec + review summary
  - Verify PR description includes: Summary, What Changed, How to Test, AI Review Summary, DoD Checklist

## Rollback Plan

<!-- GUIDANCE: Every plan needs a rollback. "Revert the PR" is acceptable for
     additive changes; it is NOT acceptable for changes that add new DB columns,
     drop columns, or modify the API contract. The Drizzle migration MUST be
     reversible — document the manual down steps since drizzle-kit does not
     generate down migrations automatically. -->

### Trigger Conditions

Roll back if any of the following occur after deployment:
- [ ] [Condition 1 — e.g., "Auth error rate exceeds 1% of login attempts in 5 minutes"]
- [ ] [Condition 2 — e.g., "P95 latency on /v1/auth/login exceeds 2 seconds"]

### Rollback Steps

**Application:**
1. [Step — e.g., "Redeploy previous image tag"]

**Database:**
- Migration rollback: [document the manual reverse SQL — drizzle-kit does not generate a `down`]
- ⚠️ **Data impact:** [e.g., "Rolling back after tokens have been issued under the new schema will orphan rows. Document cleanup steps."]

## Definition of Done

<!-- These map directly to the team DoD in CLAUDE.md. Check each before raising the PR. -->

- [ ] All acceptance criteria from the spec are met (AC-1 through AC-N)
- [ ] Unit tests pass — ≥80% coverage on all new code
- [ ] Integration tests cover all new/changed endpoints (real Postgres + Redis)
- [ ] TypeScript compiles with zero errors (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] ESLint passes with zero warnings (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets (secret-scan stop hook passed)
- [ ] `specs/openapi.yaml` updated and consistent with `src/schemas/` and `src/routes/`
- [ ] Database migration is reversible and reviewed
- [ ] Security review complete (mandatory for auth/token/PII-handling code)
- [ ] PR description includes "How to Test" instructions
- [ ] Rollback plan reviewed
